label: Physical, of a ground
resolution: Composite-bearer PHYSICAL_OF_A_GROUND_1 remains distinct from vocabulary-independent PHYSICAL_OF_A_GROUND_2, whose precise original specification semantics is unresolved. Owner-approved analyst siblings PHYSICAL_OF_A_GROUND_3 and PHYSICAL_OF_A_GROUND_4 preserve respectively name-free local definite description and cross-interpretation formula definability. They have explicit different quantifiers and parameter policies; neither is silently selected as original and no coverage or equivalence is claimed. PhysicalBearersComposite remains the explicit composition bridge. Part-freeness therefore does not itself exclude a specification-based physical rival. simpleImpersonal has no calibrated language/interpretation and remains untested under the specification readings; absence of counterexample is not compatibility.
